query:
UPDATE prekey_bundles
            SET identity_key = $3,
                signed_prekey = $4,
                signed_prekey_sig = $5,
                signed_prekey_id = $6,
                identity_key_ed = $7,
                identity_key_sig = $8,
                supports_v2 = $9,
                device_x3dh_pub = $10,
                device_sign_pub = $11,
                device_cert_sig = $12,
                client_device_id = $13,
                device_kyber_pub = $14,
                device_kyber_sig = $15,
                device_kyber_id = $16,
                updated_at = $17
            WHERE id = (
                SELECT id
                FROM prekey_bundles
                WHERE user_id = $1 AND device_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2
                ORDER BY id
                LIMIT 1
                FOR UPDATE
            )
            RETURNING id
